title: The next chapter
description: Electric thinking and combustion heritage find common ground.

cars.name: BMW i8
cars.engine: 1.5-litre turbocharged inline-three petrol with electric motor (plug-in hybrid)
cars.description: The i8 brought BMW’s plug-in hybrid technology to a dramatically shaped sports coupé. Its turbocharged three-cylinder engine drove the rear wheels while an electric motor powered the front axle. A carbon-fibre passenger cell, rising doors and sculpted rear bodywork gave this efficient approach to performance an unmistakably futuristic identity.

cost.basis: Rounded UK guide range for good to excellent standard 2014 i8 coupés. Battery condition, service history, mileage and specification affect value; later updated cars and Roadsters are separate models.

cars.name: McLaren MP4-12C
cars.description: The MP4-12C marked the start of McLaren’s modern series-production sports-car range. A carbon-fibre passenger structure, twin-turbocharged V8 and dual-clutch transmission formed its technical core. The low body, dihedral doors and restrained cabin reflected an engineering-led approach, combining exceptional performance with a surprisingly usable road-car character.

cost.basis: Rounded UK guide range for good to excellent standard 2012 MP4-12C coupés. Maintenance history, specification and modifications affect value; Spider and GT3 competition versions are excluded.

cars.name: Porsche 918 Spyder
cars.engine: 4.6-litre naturally aspirated V8 with two electric motors (plug-in hybrid)
cars.description: The 918 Spyder combined a high-revving V8 with two electric motors to explore a new form of Porsche performance. Its plug-in hybrid system and all-wheel drive brought electric assistance to the supercar experience. Removable roof panels, distinctive exhaust outlets above the engine and a rising centre console completed its striking design.

cost.basis: UK guide range for good to excellent standard 2015 918 Spyder examples. Weissach-package cars, special finishes, mileage and provenance can command different values.

cars.name: Ferrari 458 Italia
cars.description: The 458 Italia paired a naturally aspirated V8 with a seven-speed dual-clutch transmission and a sharply focused cockpit. Its flowing Pininfarina bodywork integrated aerodynamic details into a compact mid-engined shape. Triple central exhaust outlets and controls gathered around the steering wheel became distinctive features of this celebrated Ferrari generation.

cost.basis: UK guide range for good to excellent standard 2010 458 Italia coupés. Condition, mileage and service history affect value; Spider, Speciale and Challenge versions are separate markets.

cars.name: Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG
cars.engine: 6.2-litre naturally aspirated V8 petrol (6,208 cc; marketed as 6.3)
cars.description: The SLS AMG revived the gullwing door for a new Mercedes-Benz sports car. A long bonnet, rear-set cabin and naturally aspirated V8 gave it classic front-engined proportions, while an aluminium structure and rear-mounted dual-clutch transmission supplied modern engineering. Its wide stance and dramatic doors linked AMG performance with the marque’s sports-car heritage.

cost.basis: UK guide range for good to excellent standard 2010 C197 SLS AMG coupés. Roadster, GT, Black Series and Electric Drive variants have different values.
